```{r}
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("pheatmap")
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
# Load your data frame
Comp_test <- read_excel("~/In_vitro_tests/Compatibility_tests.xlsx")

# Convert to a standard data frame (for easier row name manipulation)
Comp_test <- as.data.frame(Comp_test)

# Assign the first column (Isolate IDs) as row names
# This is the line that fixes the NULL error
rownames(Comp_test) <- Comp_test[[1]]

# Remove the redundant first column from the data frame
Comp_test <- Comp_test[, -1]
```

```{r}
# Convert to matrix and ensure all contents are numeric (0 to 3)
Comp_test_mat <- as.matrix(Comp_test)
mode(Comp_test_mat) <- "numeric"

# --- Final Diagnostic Check ---
isolate_names <- rownames(Comp_test_mat)
if (is.null(isolate_names) | length(isolate_names) == 0) {
  # This should now NOT execute!
  stop("Matrix creation failed. Check your raw Excel file structure.")
} else {
  print("Matrix prepared successfully. Proceed to annotations.")
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Create Annotation Data Frames ---

# Function to extract the Genus (the text before the first underscore)
extract_genus <- function(name) {
  # This uses the safe method to extract the first element after splitting by '_'
  sapply(as.character(name), function(x) {
    strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
  })
}

isolate_names <- rownames(Comp_test_mat)
genus_names <- extract_genus(isolate_names)

# Create the annotation data frames (row names are the full isolate IDs)
ann_row <- data.frame(
  Genus = genus_names,
  row.names = isolate_names
)
ann_col <- data.frame(
  Genus = genus_names,
  row.names = isolate_names
)

# Ensure the 'Genus' column is a factor
ann_row$Genus <- factor(ann_row$Genus)

ann_col$Genus <- factor(ann_col$Genus)




# --- 2. Define Annotation Colors (Must match genus names exactly) ---
# NOTE: The names here MUST match the factor levels of ann_row$Genus exactly.
genus_colors <- setNames(
  c("#1F78B4", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FF7F00", "#6A3D9A","#B15928", "#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A", "#008080", "#FB9A99", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("Acidovorax sp.", "Bacillus sp.", "Chryseobacterium sp.", "Microbacterium sp.", "Paenibacillus sp.", "Pseudarthrobacter sp.", "Pseudomonas sp.","Rhizobiaceae sp.","Rhizobium sp.", "Sphingomonas sp.", "Streptomyces sp.")
)


ann_colors = list(
  Genus = genus_colors
)
```


```{r}
# --- 1. Reorder Isolates by Genus and Name ---

# Get the order of isolates based on Genus (primary sort) and then Isolate name (secondary sort)
# Using 'order' on the Genus factor first, then on the row names (Isolate IDs)
genus_order <- order(ann_row$Genus, rownames(Comp_test_mat))

# Reorder the matrix rows and columns
Comp_test_mat_ordered <- Comp_test_mat[genus_order, genus_order]

# Reorder the annotation data frames
ann_row_ordered <- ann_row[genus_order, , drop = FALSE]
ann_col_ordered <- ann_col[genus_order, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Plot the Expanded and Ordered Heatmap ---

# Matrix colors and breaks (as previously defined)
breaks <- c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5)
cols <- c("#1E88E5", "#FFC107", "#FF7043", "#C62828") # Green (0) to Red (3)

# Open TIFF graphics device
tiff(
  filename = "~/In_vitro_tests/Compatibility_test.tiff",
 width = 18,
 height = 16,
units = "in",
  res = 400,
  compression = "lzw"
)

pheatmap(
  Comp_test_mat_ordered, # Use the ordered matrix
  color = cols,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, # DISABLE CLUSTERING to maintain genus order
  cluster_cols = FALSE, # DISABLE CLUSTERING to maintain genus order
  annotation_row = ann_row_ordered, # Use the ordered annotations
  #annotation_col = ann_col_ordered, # Use the ordered annotations
  annotation_colors = ann_colors, 
  legend_breaks = 0:3,
  legend_labels = c("0 Fully compatible", "1 Weakly incompatible", "2 Moderately incompatible", "3 Not compatible"),
  display_numbers = FALSE,
  border_color= "grey40",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize = 9,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  #main = "Isolate–isolate compatibility",
  gaps_row = gaps_idx,
  gaps_col = gaps_idx,
  )
dev.off()
```
```{r}


breaks <- c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5)
cols   <- c("#1E88E5", "#FFC107", "#FF7043", "#C62828")

gaps_idx <- which(
  ann_row_ordered$Genus[-1] != ann_row_ordered$Genus[-nrow(ann_row_ordered)]
)

# choose figure size based on matrix size
w <- ncol(Comp_test_mat_ordered) * 0.35 + 6
h <- nrow(Comp_test_mat_ordered) * 0.35 + 4

pheatmap(
  Comp_test_mat_ordered,
  color = cols,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = ann_row_ordered,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  legend_breaks = 0:3,
  legend_labels = c(
    "0 Fully compatible",
    "1 Weakly incompatible",
    "2 Moderately incompatible",
    "3 Not compatible"
  ),
  border_color = "grey40",
  gaps_row = gaps_idx,
  gaps_col = gaps_idx,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize = 9,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  cellwidth = 14,
  cellheight = 14,
  filename = "~/In_vitro_tests/Compatibility_test.tiff",
  width = w,
  height = h
)
dev.off()

```
